title: Signature Metamorphic Engine Detection
description: Detects metamorphic engines that rewrite their own code between infections. Statistical opcode profiles and control-flow fingerprints survive mutation better than byte signatures. Detection targets the engine's habits, not its output. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.

title: Signature Code Mutation Analysis
description: Analyzes mutation techniques: register renaming, instruction substitution, junk insertion. Understanding the mutation set lets analysts normalize samples back to canonical form. Each engine has a recognizable mutation palette. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.

title: Signature Packer Detection
description: Detects packed executables by entropy, section characteristics, and stub signatures. High-entropy sections with tiny import tables scream packer; the stub unpacks the real payload at runtime. Detection routes to unpacking. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.

title: Signature Control-Flow Flattening Defense
description: Defends analysis against flattened control flow by reconstructing the dispatcher. Flattening hides logic in a switch dispatcher; deobfuscators recover the original graph. It restores analyzability. title: Signature Opaque Predicate Removal
description: Removes opaque predicates — branches that always go one way — with symbolic execution. The solver proves the predicate constant and prunes the dead branch. Code shrinks back toward readability. title: Signature Instruction Substitution Normalization
description: Normalizes substituted instructions back to canonical forms for comparison. mov eax,0 versus xor eax,eax mean the same thing; normalization erases the difference. Normalized code diffs cleanly. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.

title: Signature Anti-Disassembly Countermeasures
description: Counters anti-disassembly tricks: overlapping instructions, jump-into-middle, return abuse. Linear disassembly falls for them; recursive descent with heuristics resists. Analysts must distrust the first disassembly. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.

title: Signature Runtime Decryption Monitoring
description: Watches runtime decryption by breaking on memory-write-then-execute transitions. Packed code decrypts then jumps; the monitor dumps the decrypted image at the transition. It captures what static analysis cannot see. title: Signature Polymorphic Shellcode Detection
description: Detects polymorphic shellcode with emulation and heuristics like GetPC patterns. Network IDS emulates suspicious buffers looking for decryptor behavior. It catches what signatures miss. title: Signature Behavioral Detection
description: Detects malware by behavior — API call sequences, file and registry actions — not bytes. Mutation changes code, not intent; behavioral models catch the intent. EDR products live here. title: Signature Emulation-Based Unpacking
description: Unpacks samples by emulating them to the original entry point. The emulator runs the stub safely and dumps the unpacked image; analysts work from the dump. description: Writes YARA rules targeting mutation-invariant features: strings, opcodes, and behaviors. Good rules survive polymorphism by matching what the engine cannot change. title: Signature Entropy Analysis
description: Flags packed or encrypted regions by Shannon entropy. Normal code sits around 5 bits per byte; packed code nears 8. It is the fastest triage signal in the toolkit. title: Signature Sandbox Detonation

title: Signature Application Allowlisting
description: Allowlisting permits only known-good code to run, making polymorphism irrelevant. If the hash is not on the list, it does not execute — mutated or not. It inverts the detection problem.
